info.name: Solaris Zones Solaris Zone Configuration Resources API
info.description:
REST API for configuring Oracle Solaris Zones via the RAD zonemgr module. Provides operations for editing zone configurations, managing zone resources (network interfaces, devices, file systems, resource controls), and committing configuration changes. Corresponds to the zonecfg(1M) command functionality exposed through the RAD REST interface.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Solaris Support
 Email: solaris-support@oracle.com
